name: Cannon River (Cannon Falls–Red Wing)

gaugeContext.note: The Welch gauge provides reference flow for the lower Cannon. Lake Byllesby operations and tributaries can change local conditions. No travel-speed calibration is assigned.

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric trip-time range is assigned.

sections.difficulty: Moderate current; shallow riffles in low water
sections.notes: A shorter Cannon Falls outing ending at Sunset Trail, upstream of the closed Miesville access. Arrange your shuttle.

notices.title: Miesville access closed for construction
notices.text: The agency inventory says Miesville Ravine has no river-shoreline access during 2026 construction. Do not plan a landing there; confirm reopening with the park.

sections.routeReview: Approximate agency river-course overview. Exact landing connections and passage around obstacles are not drawn.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River trip guide and map river miles
distanceEvidence.streamId: Cannon River State Water Trail, Minnesota
distanceEvidence.note: 25.5 minus 19.1 gives approximately 6.4 river miles. Carries and shuttle travel are separate. The guide’s 2–3 hour time belongs to Riverside–Miesville and is not transferred to this different trip.

putInAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency GPS coordinate retained near the gravel/wooded bank west of the bridge. Exact landing unresolved; park identity distinguished from the same-name Northfield park.
putInAccess.directions: Use Riverside Park in Cannon Falls at the Highway 20 crossing. Find the signed carry-in beside the bridge. This is not Riverside Park in Northfield.

takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Digitized agency point is visibly in the gravel turnaround, not on the water edge. Retain it as an approximate area; do not present the parking coordinate as an exact landing.
takeOutAccess.directions: From Highway 19 east of Cannon Falls, follow Sunset Trail north to the public access. Carry boats from the gravel turnaround to the river; the marker identifies the facility area.

sections.difficulty: Moderate current; shallow riffles in low water
sections.notes: A longer paddle past Welch, ending at the developed Highway 61 access. Confirm the exit during your shuttle.

notices.title: Miesville access closed for construction
notices.text: The agency inventory says Miesville Ravine has no river-shoreline access during 2026 construction. Do not plan a landing there; confirm reopening with the park.

notices.title: Arrange your full shuttle
notices.text: Welch has no developed public landing. Do not assume an outfitter’s property is a public exit; arrange permission separately.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Digitized agency point marks the approach/parking clearing north of the river beside Highway 61. Exact shoreline landing is unresolved; retain an approximate area.
takeOutAccess.directions: Reach the public access west of Highway 61 via Green Spring Road and the access driveway. Find the carry-in path to the river before starting your shuttle.

blurb: Explore public-access trips from Cannon Falls through Welch toward Red Wing. Miesville’s 2026 shoreline closure is retained; listed trips use other access areas.
